title: Cavalry FC defeats Atlético Ottawa 3-2 to claim CPL title and historic double
summary: Cavalry FC defeated Atlético Ottawa 3-2 to claim the Canadian Premier League title and an unprecedented double in the soccer league.

image.caption: Tobias Warschewski of Cavalry FC takes a free kick in the Canadian Premier League Championship final on Saturday in Calgary. (CPL)

blocks.text: Cavalry FC defeated Atlético Ottawa 3-2 to claim the Canadian Premier League title and an unprecedented double in the soccer league.
Warschewski scores twice in Cavalry's 3-2 win to take North Star Cup
Calgary's club was the first in the league's eight-year history to earn both the regular-season Shield and the championship North Star Cup.
Cavalry star Tobias Warschewski, the CPL's player of the year, scored in the fifth and 74th minutes.
Calgary's captain Sergio Camargo struck in the 47th. Ottawa scored on a Cavalry own-goal in the 65th minute and Nicolas Fleuriau Chateau converted a penalty kick in extra time.
Cavalry also exacted revenge on Atlético after falling 2-1 in extra time in last year's snowy final at Ottawa's TD Place.
Calgary reached the CPL final a fourth straight year and won its first North Star Cup in 2024.
